name: Kareshi ni Naisho de Dorei no Watashi
original_name: 彼氏に内緒で奴隷の私
source:
Tsukasa is finally rescued from her everyday slave training at school. Now she is a lively, grateful and skillful lover of main character. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
司終於從學校每天的奴隸訓練中被解救出來。現在的她是一個活潑、感恩、技巧純熟的女孩，也是主角的情人。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]］
